title: Montessori 3-Part Cards — Community Helpers (Carrots Are Orange)

overview.description: Montessori 3-part nomenclature cards for community helpers: Fireperson, Construction Worker, Veterinarian, Mail Person (and likely more). Each helper appears in three forms: (1) image + label card (control), (2) image-only card, (3) label-only card. Child matches unlabeled images to labels, then self-checks against the control card. Classic Montessori three-period lesson format.
overview.format: Two cards per page (helper name appears twice — once for the control card with image+label, once for the label-only card to cut separately)

inclusiveLanguage.description: Uses gender-neutral job titles: 'Fireperson' (not fireman), 'Mail Person' (not mailman). Deliberate inclusive language choice.
inclusiveLanguage.value: Modern, inclusive vocabulary. All children can see themselves in any role.

sameFormatDifferentTopic.description: Identical Montessori 3-part card format as the Solar System nomenclature cards but applied to social studies (community helpers). The FORMAT is topic-agnostic — it works for any subject that has visual items + labels.
sameFormatDifferentTopic.value: Confirms the Montessori nomenclature card is a UNIVERSAL format, not subject-specific. Homa should be able to generate these for ANY topic.

notes: Second Montessori 3-part card set from Aless (first was Solar System). Confirms the format is a priority — she's showing it applied to two different subjects to demonstrate its versatility. The inclusive language (Fireperson, Mail Person) is a consistent signal with her Kennedy Center inclusive curriculum drop. This reinforces the earlier gap identified: montessori-nomenclature-cards recipe should be topic-agnostic and generatable for any subject.
